admission.contract: A public mbstring regex call accepts a non-empty pattern string and compiles it into an Oniguruma regex object.
admission.predicate: entry.hit && compile.hit && compile.time > entry.time && entry.arg_pattern_len > 0 && compile.patlen == entry.arg_pattern_len && compile.options == entry.options && compile.retval != 0
limitations: The public issue names the mbstring fuzz target but not the exact exported PHP function used to reach compilation.
This binds acceptance at the mbstring API boundary, not at the omitted fuzz harness boundary.

root.contract: A resolved subexpression-call node becomes the body of a quantified subpattern that is classified as zero-length and therefore subject to empty-repeat analysis.
root.predicate: call_bind.hit && quant_zero.hit && quant_zero.time > call_bind.time && quant_zero.body == call_bind.call_node && call_bind.call_body != 0
limitations: This candidate assumes the crashing quantifier body was a NODE_CALL; quantifiers_memory_node_info also handles other node kinds.
The source shows aliasing from a call node to a capture-group node, but the issue text does not identify the exact parse-tree shape.

target.contract: The empty-repeat analyzer later traverses that same call node and dereferences its resolved body pointer while computing quantifier emptiness.
target.predicate: call_read.hit && call_read.time > root.quant_zero.time && call_read.node == root.quant_zero.body && call_read.node_body == root.call_bind.call_body
limitations: The public issue gives only the top three stack frames, so the exact switch arm inside quantifiers_memory_node_info is not confirmed.
This binds the dangerous read to the same aliased node state, but it does not by itself prove which object had already been freed or the exact ASAN read offset.
